title: 第2274章 九重位至高大结局第2273章 不知道不确定
lines: 时光悠悠，几百年后，苏恒成长的银河系，在河系边缘位置，突然就涌现几道庞大的黑影，这里每一个黑影都几乎比一颗普通恒星还大，他们在虚空中也不是直线飞行，而是一闪一闪，跳跃着空间前行。
“舞，就要抵达星河系内部了，十几万年前我族横扫银河系，却被星河联邦打的血崩，这次卷土重来，一定要把这个星系的一切，毁灭的点滴不剩。”
等再次跳过几光年距离，其中一个最庞大的黑色阴影才扩散着自己的灵魂波动道。
若是十几万年前那些陨落的源族神王们还活着，怕不是一眼就会认出，这身影是当年最终之战，最身先士卒，最恐怖的吞星族神王极。
极的恐怖，就在于他本身是七个小千世界神王，在没有涉足到天道一级时，更没有发现合身一方星宇的契机，当年联邦的源族神王们，对于如何更进一步，从长生不老变成真正的不灭不朽，还是各有争论的。
有的认为既然神王间比拼的就是各自底蕴，小千世界数量多寡，那你一直创世下去，比如从一创世到9甚至十以上，就可能找到晋升下一位阶的道路。
或者，在成功开创几个小千世界后，能不能再把小千融合成大千？一旦成了大千造物主，创世神，说不定就晋升下一阶了。
这些争论谁对谁错，没谁知道。
大家只知道一件事，星河系在诞生诸位神王之后，再被源族劫掠了那么多物资财富后，剩下的那些东西，你要么只让某一个神王独享，才有机会让他不断进步提升，有机会去寻找新的出路。
要么，就是杀出银河系之外寻找新地盘。
而当年源族最强的神王，才只开创掌控了五个小千世界。
大家都是神王，关系也不算差，可众多神王也不会随便成全其中之一晋升下一步，独享一切资源啊，就像是路天行出身的仙域，为什么合身仙域机缘出现之前，众仙帝彼此之间其实关系不会太恶劣，也基本没大战爆发……
一旦契机出现，每次都是打生打死，导致大家都无法去独享，去晋升。
真遇到那样的机会，这不是关系好不好，坏不坏就能决定的。
源族巅峰战力弱于吞星族，所以最终一战所有神王全部陨落，只留下了银河系各族群火种。
吞星族也好不到哪去，被打的血崩，只留下两三个重伤的神王逃离，在这十几万年里默默舔舐伤口，恢复实力。
伴随七世界神王极的话，也是从最终一战里侥幸逃生的四世界神王舞，都欢快的发出一道激情的灵魂波动，“我族对比银河系诸族，在先天上还是有很大优势的，他们各族群受限于星辰珠的纯粹程度，不能随意吞噬晋升出神明强者。”
“我族不一样，什么都可以融合炼化，哪怕我族过处就只剩下一片虚无，再不存在任何宇宙物质，被称为星空毁灭者，但存在即是合理，为了不朽不灭，为宇宙众生为敌又如何？”
“十几万年，不止我们当年四个神王恢复巅峰还略微胜出，小辈里也诞生了七八位神王，星河系不可能这么快速恢复，哈哈~”
“我族纵横星空，毁灭哪一片星海，不是靠着这种惊人的恢复力横扫下去的？”
这一次卷土重来，一个七世界神王带队，两个四世界神王为主力，还有八位一二世界的神王。
他们就是要一路吞天灭地，湮灭整个星空所有物质和灵魂存在，就算他们也不知道神王之上下一步前路是什么，可只要吞光了整个宇宙，就不信找不到一丝未来。
就是在舞的笑声下，其他吞星族神王也振奋起来时，一道叹息声突然响起，这叹息初闻几不可见，一瞬又如震荡在所有吞星族神王灵魂深处的洪钟大吕，震得那些弱小的神王，都几乎有了小千世界崩塌，肉身灵魂齐齐龟裂的趋势。
所有吞星族都是大惊，为首的七世界神王极，更是化身黑洞，自体内爆发出恐怖的吸扯力，这一个庞大的黑洞内部，还若隐若现七个螺旋门户入口。
一大七小八黑洞的恐怖吸扯力，十光年范围的一颗恒星、十多颗行星包括各式各样的小天体，都犹如接收到了至高召唤，像是坠入大气层的陨石，急速向黑洞内坠落。
可这坠落气势才爆发，一只大手就出现在虚空，轻轻在虚空一抖，砰砰砰~
不止十光年内各种牵引飞舞的天体不动了，直接回归了原位，极这个掌握七方小千世界的最强神王，都也暴起了连绵不断的轰鸣声，那是一个个化身黑洞的小千世界，在这震荡中各种爆炸，碎裂。
“他不是神王，快逃！！”
随手一击就让极受到了重伤，一个小千世界崩裂大半，无穷的创世之力向外益散流逝，其他六个小千世界也有不同程度的损伤，他体内逸散出来的创世之力，都在快速淹没这一个小恒星系，使得十多颗原本都是无灵、无生命的行星，以肉眼可见速度开始演化出各种生命特征。
但极没有对生命诞生的一点惊喜和开心，有的只是无穷恐惧。
就算是当年大战最惨烈时，一个个源族神王群殴他，各式各样自爆式杀招围攻他，也不会这么轻易就让他重伤。
他都这样，那么那些单世界神王，双世界神王，被之前的大手一击捏碎，成为滋养这一方面星空的最肥沃原料和养分，也是等闲了。
这绝对不是神王！
该死，明明他们吞星族才是宇宙间最被偏爱，最受宠爱的族群，他们已经不止攻灭了一个星河联邦，还在抵达星河联邦之前，最少摧毁过三个昌盛的生命星系。
为什么？那一战之后应该彻底衰落的星河系，会突然蹦出来这样恐怖的存在？
极当然想不到，几百年前苏恒晋升现代位面银河系天道，已经有了一打多，小意思的实力，这还是指他离开自己的大本营，在域外征战。
苏恒也知道了下一步怎么发展，要么，你若是无能离开现代地球银河系所在位面，就只能横向发展，向银河系之外扩张，直到吞下整个星宇。
但苏恒可以离开啊，随时走随时回去，横跨位面遨游简单的很，这就是可以纵向发展了，他下一站是抵达路天行出身的仙域大世界，轻松暴揍了现有仙域的几个仙帝，把他们实力封印后，开开心心去演化为仙域世界的天道。
还是几十年时光，他就有了第二个身份，大千世界仙域以及其麾下几十个小千世界或者说飞升之前的下界，的主宰。
content_en:
Time flies, hundreds of years later, at the edge of the Milky Way where Su Heng grew up, several huge black shadows suddenly appeared. Each black shadow here was almost larger than an ordinary star. They did not fly in a straight line in the void, but flickered and jumped through space.
"Wu, we are about to reach the interior of the galaxy. Our clan swept across the galaxy hundreds of thousands of years ago, but was beaten to pieces by the Galaxy Federation. This time we make a comeback, we must destroy everything in this galaxy."
After jumping a few light years again, one of the largest black shadows spread the waves of his soul.
If the fallen God-Kings of the Source Clan hundreds of thousands of years ago were still alive, they would probably not be able to recognize at a glance that this figure was the most terrifying God-King of the Galactus Clan who was at the forefront of the final battle that year.
The most terrifying thing is that he is a god king of seven small thousand worlds. Before he got involved in the first level of heaven, he never found an opportunity to fit into a star universe. At that time, the source clan god kings in the federation still had their own arguments about how to go one step further and transform from immortality to true immortality.
Some people think that since the competition among the God-Kings is about their own heritage and the number of small thousand worlds, then if you continue to create worlds, for example, from creation to 9 or even ten, you may find a way to advance to the next level.
Or, after successfully creating several small thousand worlds, can we merge the small thousand worlds into the big thousand world? Once you become the Creator of the Universe and the God of Creation, you might be promoted to the next level.
No one knows who is right or wrong in these arguments.
Everyone only knows one thing. After the birth of the God-Kings in the galaxy, and after so much material wealth was plundered by the Source Clan, you must either only let a certain God-King enjoy the remaining things, so that he can continue to improve and find a new way out.
Or, go out of the galaxy to find new territory.
At that time, the most powerful God King of the Source Clan only created and controlled five small thousand worlds.
Everyone is a god king, and their relationship is not bad, but many god kings will not just help one of them advance to the next step, and have all the resources to themselves. Just like the fairyland where Lu Tianxing was born, why before the opportunity to join the fairyland appeared, the relationship between the immortal emperors was not too bad, and there was basically no war...
Once an opportunity arises, it is a life-and-death battle every time, so that no one can enjoy it exclusively and advance.
If you really encounter such an opportunity, it will not be determined by whether the relationship is good or bad.
The peak combat power of the Source Clan was weaker than that of the Galactus Clan, so in the final battle all the God-Kings fell, leaving only the fires of various ethnic groups in the galaxy.
The Galactus tribe was not much better. They were beaten to death, leaving only two or three seriously injured God-Kings to escape, silently licking their wounds and regaining their strength for hundreds of thousands of years.
Following the words of the Seventh World God King Ji, the Four Worlds God King Wu, who also narrowly escaped from the final battle, happily sent out a passionate soul wave, "Compared to other races in the galaxy, our race still has a great advantage in nature. Each of their races is limited by the purity of the Star Bead and cannot devour those who are promoted to gods at will."
"Our clan is different. Everything can be fused and refined. Even if our clan is left with nothingness and no matter in the universe anymore, we are called the destroyers of the starry sky. But our existence is reasonable. So what if we become enemies of all sentient beings in the universe for the sake of immortality?"
"In hundreds of thousands of years, not only did our four god kings return to their peak and slightly outperformed us, seven or eight god kings were also born in the younger generation. It is impossible for the galaxy to recover so quickly, haha~"
"Our clan stretches across the starry sky and destroys which starry sea. Didn't we rely on this amazing resilience to sweep through?"
This time they made a comeback, led by a seventh world god king, two fourth world god kings were the main force, and there were eight god kings from the first and second worlds.
They just want to swallow the sky and the earth all the way, and annihilate all matter and soul existence in the entire starry sky. Even they don't know what the next step is for the God King, but as long as they swallow the entire universe, they don't believe that there will be no future.
Even under Wu's laughter, when the other God-Kings of the Star-Gulfing Clan were also cheering up, a sigh suddenly sounded out. This sigh was almost invisible at first, but for a moment it was like the Hong Zhongdalu that shook the depths of the souls of all the God-Kings of the Star-Gulfing Tribe. It shook those weak God-Kings to the point where their small worlds almost collapsed, and their bodies and souls all cracked.
All the Star Eaters were shocked. The leader of the Seven Worlds God King Ji transformed into a black hole, and a terrifying suction force erupted from his body. Inside this huge black hole, seven spiral portal entrances were looming.
The terrifying suction force of the black holes, one large, seven small, and eight, a star within ten light years, more than a dozen planets, including various small celestial bodies, all seemed to have received the supreme call, like meteorites falling into the atmosphere, falling rapidly into the black hole.
But the falling momentum just exploded, and a big hand appeared in the void, shaking gently in the void, bang bang bang~
The various celestial bodies that were pulling and flying within more than ten light years stopped moving and returned directly to their original positions. Ji, the most powerful god king who controlled the seven small worlds in the seven directions, also erupted with a continuous roar. The small worlds that were transformed into black holes exploded and shattered in the shock.
"He is not the God King, run away!!"
With a casual blow, Ji was seriously injured. Most of a small thousand world collapsed, and the infinite power of creation spread outwards. The other six small thousand worlds also suffered varying degrees of damage. The power of creation escaping from his body was quickly flooding this small star system, causing more than a dozen planets that were originally inanimate and lifeless to begin to evolve various life characteristics at a speed visible to the naked eye.
But there was absolutely no surprise or joy at the birth of life, only endless fear.
Even when the war was at its worst, when the God-Kings of the Origin Clan attacked him in groups and besieged him with all kinds of self-destructive killing moves, he would not be seriously injured so easily.
He is like this, so it is easy for those single-world god-kings and double-world god-kings to be crushed by the big hand before and become the most fertile raw materials and nutrients for nourishing this aspect of the starry sky.
This is definitely not the God King!
Damn it, it is obvious that the Galactus Tribe is the most favored and favored ethnic group in the universe. They have not only destroyed one Galaxy Federation, but also destroyed at least three prosperous life galaxies before arriving at the Galaxy Federation.
Why? The galaxy that should have completely declined after that battle would suddenly have such a terrifying existence pop up?
Of course, it was extremely unexpected that Su Heng was promoted to the modern plane of the Milky Way and Tiandao hundreds of years ago and already had the strength of more than a dozen Xiaoyi. This still meant that he left his base camp and fought outside the territory.
Su Heng also knew how to develop next. Either, if you are unable to leave the plane of the modern Earth's Milky Way, you can only develop horizontally and expand outside the Milky Way until you swallow the entire galaxy.
But Su Heng can leave and go back at any time. Traveling across planes is very simple. This means he can develop vertically. His next stop is to reach the great world of the Immortal Realm where Lu Tianxing was born. He easily beats up several Immortal Emperors in the existing Immortal Realm. After sealing their strength, he happily evolves into the Heavenly Way of the Immortal Realm world.
Within a few decades, he had acquired a second identity, the master of the Immortal Realm of the Great Thousand World and dozens of smaller worlds under his command, or the lower realm before ascension.
title_en: Chapter 2274: The Finale of the Ninth Level Supreme Chapter 2273: I don’t know but I’m not sure
